description: Holdout validation of the e30 cost model on real hardware. Policies are implemented CLIENT-SIDE by controlling release timing, which is faithful because stock vLLM never holds requests back (measured in e02: queue time 0.0 ms at every level). No scheduler patch needed.
note_holdout: seed 99 and these rates were NOT used to fit the cost model — the fit came from e02's concurrency sweep at fixed n. plan_v4 requires MAPE<15% per cell on data the fit never saw.
